fieldValues.title: A person working with AI
fieldValues.summary: Someone directing AI agents whose deep context the agents lack: they need to share their assumptions so the AI knows where to focus.
jobs: Hand over the context that matters
Scope what an agent should and should not touch
Check an agent's work against intent
Keep decisions an agent cannot re-derive
fieldValues.needs: A way to state assumptions once that every agent reads, with provenance.
